summary: DeepSeek released a preview of its V4 model family (Pro and Flash MoE variants) with new architecture, 1M-token context support, and stated efficiency gains over V3.2, with checkpoints made available for download.

mechanisms.reason: A 1.6T parameter model trained on over 32T tokens represents a continued large training compute commitment.
mechanisms.quote: We pre-train both models on more than 32T diverse and high-quality tokens

mechanisms.reason: The paper claims a new state-of-the-art among open models in a maximum reasoning mode.
mechanisms.quote: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, redefines the state-of-the-art for open models, outperforming its predecessors in core tasks.

mechanisms.reason: The model extends usable context to one million tokens, which raises memory demand at scale even as per-token KV cache efficiency improves relative to the predecessor.
mechanisms.quote: both supporting a context length of one million tokens ... This enables us to routinely support one-million-token contexts, thereby making long-horizon tasks and further test-time scaling more feasible.

practices.reason: The hybrid attention design (CSA/HCA) is a concrete architectural technique for long-context efficiency, though tied to the lab's own model architecture rather than a directly reusable serving recipe.
practices.quote: a hybrid attention architecture that combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to improve long-context efficiency

notable_reason: A new DeepSeek frontier model family with large stated efficiency and long-context gains is the kind of release the sector watches closely, echoing prior DeepSeek efficiency shocks.
